subject: MATH251
filterSummary: Selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. For English, top-tier creators like 3Blue1Brown, Khan Academy, and Dr. Trefor Bazett provide excellent coverage. For Arabic, Anas Abu Zahra is a key resource, covering two of the five topics. No suitable Arabic video was found for 'Isomorphism' in a linear algebra context, as all candidates were for abstract algebra or graph theory.

coverage.topic: Kernel and Range of a Linear Transformation
Kernel and Range of a Linear Transformation

coverage.note: All candidates were for abstract algebra (groups/rings) or graph theory, not linear algebra vector spaces, and were rejected for low relevance.
